items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I -- when Herschel died, I had the opportunity of going with that band. Basie sent me a telegraph. I was afraid. I had a lot of fear, and I was with my family band, Milton Larkin Hawkins, and I just told him I couldn't make it, I didn't think I was ready.

ctx.x: We were at the Regal Theater in Chicago, and Lionel went over to (inaudible) a show for the kids at Dusevel High School and heard Johnny Play on an album. And that's when he got Johnny. (Inaudible) always good for taking you off alto and put you on tenor. He put Illinois Jacquet on tenor, who was an alto player, put Johnny Griffin on tenor, who was an alto player.
And Hamp's a tenor freak because of Herschel Evans. He used to work --
